exchange_wallet_snapshot.method: Direct rippled account_info reads for tracked wallets; XRPSCAN public labels for exchange attribution; daily same-wallet comparisons.
exchange_wallet_snapshot.interpretation: Publicly attributed exchange-controlled XRPL wallets including cold storage, omnibus customer custody and wrapped backing reserves; not tradable float, beneficial-owner holdings or official PoR.

binance_incident_reconciliation.confirmed_conclusion: The Binance-specific same-wallet decline is -173.2M over seven days in XRP Insights' tracked wallet set. The all-exchange -234.9M decline is not a Binance-only measure. CryptoQuant's approximately 220M decline is a different provider series and wallet universe.
binance_incident_reconciliation.hypothesis: The October 29 theft may explain a substantial portion of Binance's -173.2M same-wallet change, but no five-wallet crosswalk, per-wallet history or same-time PoR/customer-liability reconciliation is available.
disconfirming_or_missing_evidence: No mapping of the five incident source wallets into XRP Insights' 153-wallet Binance set.
No per-wallet daily history from XRP Insights.
No same-time Binance customer liabilities and reserve-address balance comparison.
No reconciliation of deposits, withdrawals, wallet reclassification and newly labeled wallets.

sbi_relationship.confirmed: Two XRPL wallets are publicly attributed by XRPSCAN labels to SBI VC Trade and total 59.5M XRP in the Oct30 08:00 UTC snapshot.
sbi_relationship.inference: SBI VC Trade operates material XRP exchange/custody infrastructure in Japan.
sbi_relationship.unknown: Beneficial ownership, customer-vs-proprietary allocation, exact custody arrangements and SBI Group treasury exposure.
sbi_relationship.disconfirming_evidence: The source is an exchange wallet-label aggregation, not SBI's official Proof of Reserves or a corporate treasury disclosure.

supersedes_prior_interpretation: Clarifies that the 233.46M theft must not be matched to the all-exchange -234.9M same-wallet change; the Binance-specific series is -173.2M. The prior approximately 220M CryptoQuant observation remains provider-specific and unreconciled.
